description: GTIN check digit for EAN-8, UPC-A (12 digits), EAN-13 and GTIN-14. The weight alternates 3 and 1 from the right, starting with 3 on the digit beside the check. Spaces and hyphens are ignored. This does not check that the GS1 prefix was assigned. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ean-validate
